units: No lower mortality risk associated with daily multivitamins
Three prospective cohorts, 390124 generally healthy adults over 20 years
Benefits and harms remain unclear beyond measured association

mortality and cognitive improvement from multivitamins

units: High-intensity walking improved frailty classification more than casual walking

69.6 versus 46.4 percent improved, OR 2.91 and confidence interval
Imputed analyses did not retain statistical significance
No longer-term outcomes or co-interventions measured
queries: Direct experimental comparison with missing-data limitations.

context_rules.meaning: Favorable complete-case trial finding must be considered alongside nonsignificant missing-data sensitivity analyses; human severity pending.

source_inconsistencies: Abstract versus discussion differ in female percentage (79 versus 89).
Trial registration text and linked identifier differ; source inconsistency is not automatically an engine hallucination.
